CSS can be applied inline, internally (in a <style> element), or externally (from a separate CSS file).
Place a link element in the document’s <head>, for example: <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">.

Use @keyframes to define animation steps, then apply them with properties such as animation-name, animation-duration, and animation-iteration-count. For example: @keyframes fade { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } } .box { animation: fade 2s; }. For a transition, set a transition property and change a style, often on hover: .box { transition: background-color 0.5s; } .box:hover { background-color: blue; }. The transition property specifies which property changes and how long the change takes.
